question: What is a benefit of using the Cisco UCS Lightweight upgrade feature?
options: A soft reboot is available for the fabric interconnects.
The firmware version of a component is updated only when it has been modified.
All servers are rebooted to push the latest updates.
Security updates are scheduled with the next reboot of the fabric interconnects.
theory: The Cisco UCS Lightweight upgrade capability compares a component's currently running firmware against the version targeted by the upgrade and only actually updates (and reboots, where applicable) components whose firmware version has genuinely changed, skipping components that already match. This selective behavior reduces unnecessary reboots and shortens overall upgrade time, unlike a blanket approach that would reboot or reflash every server/component regardless of whether its firmware version actually needs to change. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 14 — UCS Firmware Updates, Lightweight Upgrade)
